title: Protocol to Generate Senescent Cells from the Mouse Hepatic Cell Line AML12 to Study Hepatic Aging
protocol: Remove and discard culture medium from the precultured AML12 flask.
Rinse the cell layer with prewarmed 1× autoclaved PBS to remove all traces of serum.
Add 2.0 mL of TrypLE™ to T25 flask.
Incubate at 37°C for 3–5 minutes and observe cells under an inverted microscope.
Extend incubation time (if required) so that the cell monolayer is dispersed (usually within 5–10 minutes).
Do not agitate the cells by hitting or shaking the flask to avoid clumping.
Add 8.0 mL of complete growth medium and aspirate cells by gently pipetting.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 250 x g for 5 minutes.
Do not use higher x g for centrifugation to avoid clumping.
Suspend cell pellet in 1.0 mL complete medium and check cell number using cell counter.
Seed 4 × 10^6 cells in 20 mL complete medium into one T175 flask.
Do not use >4 × 10^6 cells while seeding to avoid >50% confluency next day (day 1).
Check T175 flask containing AML12 cells under inverted microscope.
Ensure cells have reached approximately 50% confluency.
Change complete growth media to prewarmed basal media containing 1.0 mM H2O2 if confluency is appropriate.
Incubate the cells for 1 hour in a cell culture incubator at 37°C.
After 1 hour, change the basal media to complete growth media for recovery.
Incubate cells in the cell culture incubator at 37°C for 23 hours.
Check flask containing AML12 cells under inverted microscope for cell health.
Change complete growth media from the flask to prewarmed basal media containing 750 μM H2O2.
Incubate the cells for 1 h in a cell culture incubator at 37°C.
After 1 hour, change the basal media back to complete growth media for recovery.
Incubate cells in the cell culture incubator at 37°C for the next 23 hours.
Repeat steps of H2O2 treatment and recovery 4 times until day 6.
Sub-culture AML12 cells if they become confluent, following a 1:3 or 1:2 ratio as needed.
Check flask containing senescent AML12 under inverted microscope for cell health and morphological changes.
Remove and discard culture medium from the flask.
Rinse the cell layer with prewarmed 1× autoclaved PBS to remove all traces of serum.
Add 2.0 to 3.0 ml of TrypLE™ to a flask, incubate at 37°C for 3–5 min and observe cells under an inverted microscope.
Extend incubation time (if required) so that the cell monolayer is dispersed.
Add 6.0 to 8.0 ml of complete growth medium and aspirate cells by gently pipetting.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 250 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Suspend the cell pellet in 1.0 mL complete medium.
Check cell number using a cell counter.
Seed the cells in appropriate cultureware according to experimental requirements.
Normalize final results appropriately to either protein content or cell number.
Cryopreserve senescent cells for future experiments if needed.
